Dear colleagues at Metallbau Steinfelder KG,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +2.3% (fc:330030@2026-09). German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 14.01 per unit, payment 90 days net, lead time 42 days.
Option B: EUR 13.78 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days.
Option C: EUR 13.87 per unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 42 days.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Motor IE3 4 kW: framework renewal
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Vesmo Elektromotory a.s.,

Thank you for sending your renewal quote. Our counterproposal rests on our assessment of the growing volume opportunity and the commercial value of a longer agreement.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.1% (sc:70520@2026Q3).

A longer agreement offers clearer account visibility in exchange for improved pricing, while our growing forecast supports planning without guaranteeing orders. We are flexible on payment terms and have linked each payment option to its price; which works best for your approval process?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 217.05 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, Incoterm EXW.
Option B: EUR 213.42 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24-month agreement, Incoterm EXW.
Option C: EUR 214.88 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, Incoterm EXW.

We appreciate the relationship and look forward to agreeing a practical renewal package.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Motor IE3 4 kW: framework renewal
messages.body: Simulated supplier. Our counter-offer.

messages.subject: Re: Motor IE3 4 kW: framework renewal
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Vesmo Elektromotory a.s.,

Thank you for your counteroffer and the price movement towards our position. We recognise your concession and are making a modest step in return, with the expectation of further movement from your side.

We are flexible on the incoterm: under the EXW option, we take responsibility for collection and onward transport in exchange for a lower price. The FCA and DAP options link greater delivery responsibility on your side to higher prices; which arrangement works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 222.28 per unit, Incoterm DAP, 24-month agreement, payment 14 days net.
Option B: EUR 215.81 per unit, Incoterm EXW, 24-month agreement, payment 14 days net.
Option C: EUR 217.96 per unit, Incoterm FCA, 24-month agreement, payment 14 days net.

We appreciate your constructive engagement and look forward to continuing our supply relationship.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
